svg.title: Statistics: homework portfolio, Sapienza University of Rome, academic year 2026/27
svg.desc: The opening sheet of the portfolio, printed on normal probability paper. It carries the author's title block (Marco Verri, MSc in Cybersecurity) and Fig. 0, a simulated normal probability plot of 40 observations (seed 2627) whose points fall close to the fitted straight line.

text.tspan: Interactive essays in which the building blocks
of cryptography are implemented from their
standards and put to statistical test.

svg.text: n = 40 · mean −0.01 · SD 0.91 · r = 0.993 · seed 2627 · population N(0, 1)
